The new species is morphologically similar to P. scurra and P. divinator but differs from the both species by having hind leg with tibia and tarsus white with blackish markings (predominantly red in two other species); also differs from P. scurrai by lack of anteromedian keel on the second tergite (Fig. 9) and shorter ovipositor (Fig. 1), and from P. divinator by longer second tergite (Fig. 9).
